description: This file implements classes and functions related to Netlink socket communication in the WPEFramework core module. It includes serialization/deserialization, sending/receiving messages, and internal handling of Netlink frames.

classes.name: Netlink
classes.description: Class responsible for serializing and deserializing Netlink messages, managing sequence IDs, and providing message type and flags.

classes.name: SocketNetlink
classes.description: Class managing Netlink socket connection, sending and receiving Netlink messages, and maintaining pending message list.

methods.name: uint16_t Serialize(uint8_t stream[],const uint16_t length) const
methods.description: Serializes Netlink message headers and payloads into a byte stream for transmission.

methods.name: uint16_t Deserialize(const uint8_t stream[],const uint16_t streamLength)
methods.description: Deserializes received Netlink messages from a byte stream into internal structures.

methods.name: uint32_t Send(const Core::Netlink & outbound,const uint32_t waitTime)
methods.description: Queues a Netlink message and triggers sending over the socket, waits for response or timeout.

methods.name: uint32_t Exchange(const Core::Netlink & outbound,Core::Netlink & inbound,const uint32_t waitTime)
methods.description: Sends a Netlink message and waits for a corresponding reply, handling both request and response.

methods.name: uint16_t SendData(uint8_t * dataFrame,const uint16_t maxSendSize)
methods.description: Prepares data to be sent over the socket by selecting pending messages.

methods.name: uint16_t ReceiveData(uint8_t * dataFrame,const uint16_t receivedSize)
methods.description: Processes incoming data frames, matching responses with pending requests or handling unsolicited messages.

methods.name: void StateChange()
methods.description: Placeholder for signaling socket state changes; no implementation details provided.

methods.name: void DumpFrame(const TCHAR prefix[],const uint8_t frame[],const uint16_t length)
